حَقَقٌ , in a horse, The quality of not sweating: (S, * K:) which is a fault. (TA.) ―
-b2- And, in a horse also, The putting down the hind hoof in the place [that has just before been that] of the fore hoof: (S, * K:) which is also a fault. (K.) [See أَحَقُّ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
